notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 4.
description:
Activate Nykthos's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Nykthos.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Nykthos.
Repeat.
